# invictae

> Agentic cross-chain swap CLI — stables, native coins, and tokenized stocks across 12 chains, in one command. Dependency-light, JSON-first, with on-chain refund guarantees and local policy guardrails.

## For agents
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): how to drive the CLI, with safety rules
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the stdout/stderr contract, JSON shapes, recipes
- `invictae schema`: the full interface as JSON
- `invictae-mcp`: Model Context Protocol server (stdio) in the same package

## Docs
- [README.md](README.md): install, examples, commands, trust model
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): reporting, supply-chain posture
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
